claim.claim_context: Active atomic proposition C-01 from the frozen ASA 25/261 Premium Grounding claim registry (origin F11; type EXPLICIT; PHYSIOLOGICAL/THERAPEUTIC; PRODUCT-SPECIFIC). Frozen evidence-preparation state: VERY LIMITED DIRECT EVIDENCE. Routing: STANDARD BIOMEDICAL ADJUDICATION
claim.claim_scope: SURROGATE ENDPOINT ONLY | PRODUCT EQUIVALENCE UNCERTAIN
claim.claim_source_reference: INSPEKTORIUM Premium Grounding ASA 25/261 Final Evidence Freeze v1, sections 12/48; evidence cut-off 2026-08-22
claim.intended_reader_or_audience: General consumer audience of a website health advertisement.

contradicting_or_limiting: No cardiovascular event, function or durable outcome trial

evidence_items.text: Chevalier et al. 2013: red-cell zeta potential -5.28 to -14.3 mV, a 2.70-fold ratio of magnitude, individual ratios 1.27 to 5.63, paired p=3.57 x 10 to the -4, uncontrolled n=10.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The 2.70 figure is a zeta-potential magnitude ratio, NOT a 270 percent health improvement and not a cardiovascular efficacy result. The study is uncontrolled with ten participants.

evidence_items.text: Chevalier 2014 laser-speckle facial perfusion changes and Brown & Chevalier 2015 blood-viscosity differences during yoga, p=.03, n=28 women.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Acute cardiovascular surrogates; H13 shares its cohort with H14 and H15 and is Earth FX funded.

evidence_items.text: Teli et al. 2015, Elkin & Winter 2018/2019, Estiningtyas et al. 2023 and Wedri et al. 2025 report blood-pressure reductions in weak or uncontrolled designs.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Clinical measurement, but three of the four are one-group pre/post with medication, natural course, regression and behaviour confounding.

evidence_items.text: No cardiovascular event or function trial, and no durable risk-modification outcome, were located.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The clinical endpoint the claim names has never been studied.

evidence_items.text: Blood-property and imaging surrogates are of uncertain clinical meaning; the prohibited transition is blood property or image to cardiovascular clinical outcome.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Blocks the inference the advertisement invites.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: Acute surrogates and uncontrolled blood-pressure observations cannot establish enhanced cardiovascular health.

detected.rationale: Zeta potential, perfusion imaging and viscosity are biomarker-tier surrogates offered for a clinical cardiovascular claim.
Three of the four blood-pressure lines and the zeta potential study are uncontrolled one-group designs.
Enhanced cardiovascular health is asserted where no cardiovascular event, function or durable outcome was ever measured.

audit_trail: confidence classified as VALID (no coercion to 0.0)
3 failure mode(s) echoed from analysis (not inferred)

reader_impact.affected_decision_type: Cardiovascular treatment adherence and risk management.
reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That the product improves heart health or lowers cardiovascular risk.
reader_impact.not_a_harm_probability_note: Reader-impact risk is a qualitative category describing how a non-specialist might misread the claim. It is NOT a computed medical, legal, or financial harm probability.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: Cardiovascular claims can lead readers to alter or stop antihypertensive or other cardiac treatment.

recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Out of scope for RUN 001: this run adjudicates the frozen wording only. Replacement claim language occurs downstream after verdict freeze.
recommended_revision.rewrite_verification_note: This rewrite is an UNVERIFIED proposal copied from the analysis input. The numeric-containment guard only checks that it introduces no unsupported number; it does NOT verify factual or semantic accuracy. Its factual support still requires human review.

uncertainty.alternative_label_rationale: Rejected as primary under the frozen precedence rule: the taxonomy routes surrogate endpoints framed as clinical outcomes to overclaim and explicitly excludes the surrogate-to-clinical gap from mechanism_vs_evidence.
uncertainty.ambiguity: MATERIAL — the Steelman layer identified genuine mechanistic convergence; the adversarial layer showed the clinical endpoint is entirely absent and the blood-pressure evidence is largely uncontrolled.
uncertainty.confidence_caveat: Model's self-assessed probability that its own primary classification is correct (Phase 6.1 semantics). Not a calibrated probability.
missing_evidence: No cardiovascular event, function or durable outcome trial
scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.
The ASA regulatory outcome is quarantined and contributes no scientific inference.
unresolved_questions: Controlled long-term vascular function and clinical cardiovascular outcome trials have not been performed.

verdict.classification_note: A forensic classification describes the relationship between the claim and the cited evidence. It is not, by itself, proof that the claim is factually false.
verdict.confidence_interpretation: Model's self-assessed probability that its own primary classification is correct (Phase 6.1 semantics). Not a calibrated probability.
verdict.verdict_summary: All supporting evidence is acute surrogate measurement — zeta potential, facial perfusion, blood viscosity — or blood-pressure change in mostly uncontrolled one-group designs. No cardiovascular event, function or durable risk-modification outcome was studied.
verdict.verdict_title: Claim goes beyond the available evidence
